description: Where run may use the Geobasis NRW nDOM50 (ADR-018, plan D4; opt-in, so only with run --source de.nrw_ndom): a coarse WGS84 longitude/latitude ring around North Rhine-Westphalia, drawn by hand for this repository (CC0) and generous over the borders. Outside the state the service returns no data and no override is written. Checked 2026-11-09 against the WCS DescribeCoverage envelope (EPSG:25832 x 278000..536000, y 5560000..5828000).
